environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) with Docker Compose. Environment variables are set statically in docker-compose.yml. DEBUG_MODE=true is set for troubleshooting. No reverse proxy or WAF in front of the application. Secrets are static and never rotated. The application listens directly on port 8080 exposed to the internet via security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080.
